title: Machine-learning models identify prostate-cancer diagnostic and metastasis-associated biomarkers
summary: Expression-dataset analyses produced prostate-cancer diagnostic and metastasis-related models and prioritized POLD1 for further assessment. Separate GEO datasets and a tissue microarray provided follow-up evidence; computational drug-response predictions are not experimental treatment evidence.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers and a LASSO model built diagnostic and metastasis-risk predictions from expression-derived features.
organization: Department of Urology, The First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University, Harbin, China

evidence.tested: The models were assessed on GEO datasets; tissue-microarray immunohistochemistry provided follow-up for POLD1 expression.
evidence.unknown: Predictive and biomarker evidence does not establish a biological mechanism or treatment efficacy; drug-response analyses remain computational.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning classifiers and a LASSO model built diagnostic and metastasis-risk predictions from expression-derived features.

source_review.scope: Primary full-text review as recorded in case evidence; record-level claim and attribution review.
